## Delivery status
Backlog. Only the owner accepts and completes this story.

## User story / purpose
As a ..., I want ..., so that ... . Technical enablers may state the supported outcome directly.

## Scope and exclusions

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable success behavior
- [ ] Failure, offline and recovery behavior
- [ ] Relevant accessibility and platform behavior

## Dependencies
Link prerequisites and describe what must be accepted and merged.

## Design handoff
Flows, mockups, states, responsive layout, copy, accessibility and motion. For nonvisual work explain why visual design is unnecessary and specify interfaces/errors.

## Validation and owner review steps
Commands, fixtures, runnable artifact and criterion-to-evidence mapping.

## Documentation changes
Public APIs, configuration, schema, errors, user help and recovery as applicable.

## Engineering handoff
PR, exact commit, checks, limitations, screenshots/demo.

## Owner decision
Pending. Agents must not fill this in as acceptance.
